note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 against HEAD dfd640aede after 038795338e changed maintainSA. RFC 7296 Section 2.21.4: "A node receiving a suspicious message from an IP address (and port, if NAT traversal is used) with which it has an IKE SA SHOULD send an IKE Notify payload in an IKE INFORMATIONAL exchange over that SA." The only maintainSA change is in the reestablish exit: the goodbye goes out under out.newSA when a peer request deleted the old IKE SA to confirm a rekey, and the new SA then forgets its keys. The Section 2.21.4 path is untouched: maintainSA still defers ps.saEndpoint.Store(nil) on every exit, publishes the SA endpoint at the top of every pass (publishSAEndpoint), and answers ps.suspicious through informSuspicious on the owner goroutine. rfc7296_suspicious_test.go and notify_suspicious.go are byte-identical between a617f53893 and HEAD. The five TestSus units still assert a protected INFORMATIONAL INVALID_IKE_SPI notify over the existing SA, endpoint and NAT-T port discrimination, response and IKE_SA_INIT exclusion, the rate limit, and notification from a moved endpoint through the real owner loop including endpoint withdrawal on exit. Verdict retained from source review; no new execution result is claimed by this rejudgment.
